summary: Completed comprehensive testing of /donations page rebuild. All core functionality working: 3-step wizard (tier selection, user info, PayPal receipt), draft persistence, admin confirm/reject flow, responsive layout (no overflow at any breakpoint), PayPal integration (real <a> links with target=_blank), invoice downloads, and 'Mes dons' tracking. Minor note: FR/EN language switching redirects to homepage instead of persisting on /donations page.

design_issues.issue: Clicking FR/EN buttons redirects to homepage instead of staying on /donations page with language changed
design_issues.note: Language switching works globally but doesn't persist when navigating directly to /donations. Users can still access FR/EN content by switching language on homepage first.
